recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered composition featuring a sequence of four human portraits staggered diagonally, integrated with bold, saturated color fields and heavy geometric typography. The style utilizes high-contrast lighting, soft-focus color overlays, and a distinct early-digital graphic sensibility.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal repetition of facial profiles creating depth
Interaction between sharp photographic elements and soft airbrushed color blocks
Vertical text anchoring the left margin against horizontal text in the top right
Primary color palette (red, blue, yellow) contrasting with natural skin tones

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects arranged in a receding diagonal line from bottom-left to top-right, increasing in scale toward the right foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, vertical red and blue text block on the left edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal line of faces from the bottom-left up to the largest face on the right, then moves to the top-right text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with subjects and graphic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Yellow (background gradient) and Red (primary text and clothing accents)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cyan/Blue (foreground shapes and text) and Magenta (soft-focus overlays)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extremely high saturation in graphic elements against mid-tone photographic skin values.

letterConstructionRules: Square proportions with rounded outer corners
Vertical orientation for the primary title
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'u' and 'n' treated as mirrored geometric arcs
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between vertical, oversized display type and horizontal, smaller secondary type.

preserve: Vertical orientation of the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the square, technical feel of the 90s dance aesthetic.
Provides the necessary weight and vertical presence for the display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a sequence of four portraits staggered diagonally from bottom-left to top-right. Apply a yellow-to-white radial gradient background. Overlay large, soft-edged blocks of cyan and magenta color that partially obscure the subjects with a motion-blur effect.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, geometric sans-serif text vertically along the left edge in red and blue. Place a smaller horizontal subtitle in the top right corner using a similar square-sans font. Include a small circular spiked icon between the vertical text elements.

verificationChecks: Is the text on the left oriented vertically?
Are the colors primary and highly saturated?
Is there a diagonal progression of faces?
Does the background feature a yellow gradient?

adjustableVariables: Number of portraits in the sequence
Specific primary colors used in the overlays
Degree of motion blur on the color blocks
Font weight of the display text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the vertical text is legible despite the rotation.
Check that the color overlays don't completely obscure the facial features.
Verify the grain/texture matches an early 90s print quality.
Confirm the radial gradient is centered behind the subjects.
recipe.reuseFormula: Staggered diagonal portraits + Primary color overlays + Vertical geometric display type + Yellow radial gradient background.
